span.p:
markPending() writes id+side+since
and SAVES STATE before the order is sent
id = ct-SYMBOL-side-aN-barTimestamp

clearPending(), books updated

span.p:
outcome UNKNOWN (read-back failed)
marker deliberately KEPT — next cycle investigates,
never resends blindly

span.p:
id no longer open → clearPending()
+ reconcile(ownFillLikely=true) so a base increase
is attributed to OUR fill, not foreign inventory

span.p:
Crash anywhere here is safe:
the id is on disk before the order exists,
so a restart recognises its own order
instead of duplicating it.
orderAttempt++ only when the venue SAW the id
(so a truly unknown outcome reuses the same id).
